ابتعثا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثَا (ibtaʕaṯā) /ib.ta.ʕa.θaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثَا (ubtuʕiṯā) /ub.tu.ʕi.θaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعِثَا (ibtaʕiṯā) /ib.ta.ʕi.θaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
